judgement.reason: Tuwunel keeps all homeserver data in an embedded RocksDB database on local disk (database_path), and Deployz has only ephemeral container disks with no PostgreSQL or MySQL option for this app.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (database_path = /database (nix/pkgs/complement/config.toml)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: The selected Dockerfile configures Tuwunel with an embedded RocksDB database at /database, which holds durable homeserver data, and no shown setting moves that data to PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or S3.
